country: Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka

fields.climate: tropical monsoon; northeast monsoon (December to March); southwest monsoon (June to October)
fields.terrain: mostly low, flat to rolling plain; mountains in south-central interior
fields.resources: limestone, graphite, mineral sands, gems, phosphates, clay, hydropower, arable land
fields.farm: rice, coconuts, tea, sugarcane, plantains, milk, fiber crops, cassava, chicken, pumpkins/squash
fields.exports: garments, tea, precious stones, used rubber tires, rubber products
fields.industries: processing of rubber, tea, coconuts, tobacco and other agricultural commodities; tourism; clothing and textiles; mining
fields.religions: Buddhist (official) 70.2%, Hindu 12.6%, Muslim 9.7%, Roman Catholic 6.1%, other Christian 1.3%, other 0.05%
fields.legal: mixed system of Roman-Dutch civil law, English common law, Jaffna Tamil customary law, and Muslim personal law
fields.military: generally 18-24 years of age for voluntary military service for men and women, although upper age limits may vary by branch of service, roles, specialties, etc; no conscription
